summary: Diversified Energy Company filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing definitive agreements dated September 2, 2026, to acquire Birch Permian Holdings, Inc. via reverse merger, plus affiliated entities through two related purchase agreements. Aggregate consideration is approximately $1.8 billion, inclusive of debt repayment, for roughly 46,000 net Midland Basin mineral acres and 500 gross operated wells with midstream and water infrastructure. Funding is expected via a ~$1.5 billion asset-backed securitization plus revolver liquidity, closing simultaneously in fourth quarter 2026, subject to HSR and customary conditions.
